alt.en: A dark sea at night under heavy clouds. The moon breaks through at the top and throws a path of light down onto the water; the flat-topped cliffs of the North Cape stand pale on the horizon, and a small boat with figures rows in the foreground.
alt.zh: 夜晚，浓云下的一片暗海。月亮从顶端的云中透出，在水面上铺下一条光路；北角平顶的悬崖在地平线上泛着微光，前景里一条小船载着几个人在划行。

note.en: Balke travelled to the far north of Norway as a young man and returned to the North Cape in his paintings for the rest of his life, often on a small scale. His brushwork is fast and almost modern, with the light scraped and dragged across the sea. It is the northernmost place on this wall.
note.zh: 巴尔克年轻时到过挪威最北端，此后一生在画中反复回到北角，常常是小幅。他的笔触迅疾，几乎是现代的，光被刮擦、拖抹在海面上。这是这面墙上最北的一个地方。
